description: This file is a shell script used for testing and interacting with Git remote functionalities, including setup, configuration, renaming, fetching, updating references, pruning, and various remote operations.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Sets up a new Git repository with an initial commit and a side branch.

methods.name: tokens_match
methods.description: Compares two token lists for equality, sorting them beforehand.

methods.name: check_remote_track
methods.description: Checks if a remote tracks the specified branch set.

methods.name: check_tracking_branch
methods.description: Checks if the tracking branches for a remote are as expected.

methods.name: get_url_test
methods.description: Tests the 'git remote get-url' command with various options.

methods.name: test_extra_arg
methods.description: Tests various Git remote subcommands with extra arguments to ensure proper error handling.
